steakhouse-financial.entry: Steakhouse documents vaults on Morpho and Kamino. Identify the specific Steakhouse vault and verify its network, deposit asset, cap, available liquidity and curator permissions.
steakhouse-financial.action: If the vault terms fit your risk budget, deposit the accepted asset into that vault and record the shares received. Review collateral and operator exposure.
steakhouse-financial.exit: Check redeemable shares and available liquidity, redeem via the same vault when available, and reconcile assets received.
steakhouse-financial.capital: Vault-specific lending asset on Morpho or Kamino.
steakhouse-financial.fees: Confirm selected vault fees and gas.
steakhouse-financial.settlement: Redeem against available liquidity in the specific vault.
steakhouse-financial.risks: Curator allocation, collateral and withdrawal liquidity.

gauntlet.entry: Identify a Gauntlet-curated Morpho vault. Compare its market allocations, collateral exposure, accepted asset, cap and withdrawable liquidity.
gauntlet.action: If the vault is open and the exposure fits your budget, supply the accepted asset and record your share balance. Monitor allocation and borrower collateral risk.
gauntlet.exit: Preview redemption from the same Morpho vault, check available liquidity, redeem when supported and reconcile proceeds.
gauntlet.capital: Underlying of the selected Morpho vault plus gas.
gauntlet.fees: Some vaults charge performance fees and others charge zero; check the exact market.
gauntlet.settlement: Exit depends on the vault liquidity available to depositors.

veda.entry: Identify the specific Veda BoringVault product. Verify its Teller configuration, supported asset and share terms in the product documentation.
veda.action: Use the product's verified deposit interface only after reviewing its share pricing, strategist permissions and downstream strategy risks. Record shares received.
veda.exit: Check the product's share lock and withdrawal route before funding. If it uses the documented BoringQueue, submit a withdrawal request and wait for fulfillment.
veda.capital: Vault-specific Teller deposit asset and gas.
veda.fees: Check the integrator fee schedule before signing.
veda.settlement: BoringQueue requests have configurable maturity and require a solver.
veda.risks: Oracle valuation, restricted shares and unfilled requests.

usdd.entry: The guide covers TRON. Check the collateral type, debt terms and liquidation threshold. Use TronLink with sufficient TRX for transaction costs.
usdd.action: Open the chosen vault, deposit approved collateral and mint USDD only if you intend to manage the debt. Keep a collateral buffer and monitor liquidation risk.
usdd.exit: Check outstanding debt and charges, repay the required USDD and recover collateral subject to the vault's close conditions.
usdd.capital: Supported collateral plus TRX for network fees.
usdd.fees: Collateral types have different stability fees.
usdd.settlement: Repay outstanding debt and confirm collateral release.
usdd.risks: Collateral liquidation and stablecoin price risk.

upshift.entry: Select an Upshift vault and verify its input asset, curator, fees and withdrawal conditions. Review strategy and NAV risk.
upshift.action: Deposit the vault's accepted asset if terms are suitable. Record the receipt tokens and compare reported NAV with the underlying strategy exposure.
upshift.exit: Follow that vault's withdrawal process, confirm any waiting period and reconcile the underlying assets received.
upshift.capital: Underlying accepted by the chosen Upshift vault.
upshift.fees: Quote transaction fees and verify vault charges.
upshift.settlement: Redeem shares through the vault for underlying assets; timing is strategy-specific.
upshift.risks: NAV loss and available withdrawal liquidity.

onre.entry: Check access terms and redemption conditions. The FAQ describes ONyc minting with supported USDC or USDG through a compatible Solana wallet.
onre.action: If eligible and willing to accept reinsurance underwriting and NAV risk, place a mint order and confirm settlement before counting the ONyc balance.
onre.exit: Check the current redemption window, applicable holding restrictions and liquidity. Compare primary redemption with a secondary quote before exiting.
onre.capital: Approved subscription asset for ONyc on Solana.
onre.fees: Check primary redemption charges versus secondary-market spread.
onre.settlement: Primary redemption through OnRe; secondary exit depends on liquidity.
onre.risks: Insurance underwriting, screening and liquidity exposure.

symbiotic.entry: Verify the specific vault's single collateral token, deposit access, operator and network exposure, slashing policy and epoch duration.
symbiotic.action: If access is open and the slashing exposure fits your budget, deposit the verified collateral and record the position.
symbiotic.exit: Request withdrawal, check the claimable epoch and remaining slashing exposure, then claim when the vault permits it.
symbiotic.capital: Collateral asset named by the specific vault.
symbiotic.fees: Obtain transaction quotes; operator terms vary.
symbiotic.settlement: Check the epoch for withdrawal request and claim eligibility.
symbiotic.risks: Slashing, curator and epoch lock exposure.

lofty.entry: Confirm marketplace account requirements and review the chosen property's share terms, expenses, vacancy exposure and recent order activity.
lofty.action: If the property exposure is suitable, use the marketplace to place a share order and record its fill price and fees.
lofty.exit: Check bids and selling costs before listing shares. Treat the exit as complete when an order fills and proceeds settle.
lofty.capital: Property shares; check account verification and live order minimum.
lofty.fees: Issuer guide lists 2.5% on purchases and 3% on sales. Verify the selected order.
lofty.settlement: Sale requires an executable order; cash withdrawal requires verification.
lofty.risks: Real-estate price, vacancy and resale liquidity.

lightning-network.entry: Prepare a compatible Lightning node or wallet with bitcoin, on-chain fee budget and a suitable peer. Check channel backup and monitoring requirements.
lightning-network.action: If you need a payment channel, open and fund it, wait for the required confirmation and check outbound and inbound liquidity before using it.
lightning-network.exit: Prefer a cooperative close when both peers are available. Account for on-chain fees and possible force-close delays before treating funds as spendable.
lightning-network.capital: BTC channel funding, with adequate inbound/outbound liquidity.
lightning-network.fees: Funding and closure consume onchain fees; routed payments may incur forwarding fees.
lightning-network.settlement: Cooperative close requires both signatures; unilateral closure can delay spending.
lightning-network.risks: Channel liquidity, counterparty availability and wallet backup.

sentora-curator.entry: For the Sentora Tempo Morpho route, verify the exact vault, pathUSD supply asset, gas asset, cap and access before funding.
sentora-curator.action: If the live vault accepts deposits, preview supplying pathUSD and record the shares. Review the isolated cbBTC collateral, oracle and utilization exposure.
sentora-curator.exit: Check the Morpho vault withdrawal quote and available liquidity, redeem shares for pathUSD when available, and reconcile the amount received.
sentora-curator.capital: pathUSD plus gas on Tempo; vault cap and any minimum require a live quote.
sentora-curator.fees: Quote network, vault and exit costs in the interface; no universal fee is assumed.
sentora-curator.settlement: Dependent on confirmations and withdrawal liquidity.
sentora-curator.risks: cbBTC collateral, oracle pricing, collateral liquidation and isolated-market liquidity.

cian-yield-layer.entry: Select a CIAN stETH Yield Layer deployment. Verify supported inputs, caps, gas and exact withdrawal terms for that vault.
cian-yield-layer.action: If the vault is open and terms fit, preview approval and deposit and record the receipt token. Review downstream strategy and leverage exposure.
cian-yield-layer.exit: Request withdrawal against the receipt token and track settlement. The general guide estimates about five days; the selected vault can differ.
cian-yield-layer.capital: A supported asset for the selected layer plus gas; verify vault minimum, cap and access.
cian-yield-layer.fees: CIAN documents 8% of profits and 0.02% of exit NAV for applicable active strategies. Verify actual settings and gas.
cian-yield-layer.settlement: General user guide estimates about five days for withdrawal; confirm per vault.
cian-yield-layer.risks: Leverage, receipt-token pricing, downstream contracts and delayed redemption.

plume-vaults.entry: Select a Plume vault and verify which of USDC, USDT or pUSD it accepts, the supported network and any access requirements.
plume-vaults.action: Review the underlying assets and preview a deposit. Record the vault shares and check the liquidity schedule.
plume-vaults.exit: Compare instant redemption if liquid with the vault-specific queue. Check fees, minimum wait and actual liquidity before requesting redemption.
plume-vaults.capital: A supported stablecoin plus gas; minimum and access vary by vault.
plume-vaults.fees: Instant or queued redemption fees vary by vault and asset; use the current quote.
plume-vaults.settlement: Instant only with liquidity; queued settlement can exceed the minimum wait.
plume-vaults.risks: Underlying RWA liquidity, stablecoin depeg, redemption queues and operator risk.

lagoon.entry: Identify an asynchronous Lagoon vault, the accepted asset, curator, fee settings and deposit permissions.
lagoon.action: Preview a deposit request, wait for the applicable settlement, then check and claim vault shares through the supported interface.
lagoon.exit: Submit a redemption request if terms fit. Check valuation and settlement status before claiming the underlying asset.
lagoon.capital: Vault-specific underlying asset plus gas; verify minimum, cap and access.
lagoon.fees: Vault management and high-water-mark performance fees can apply. Verify configured rates and gas.
lagoon.settlement: Curator and oracle settlement cadence controls claimability; quote the selected vault.
lagoon.risks: Curator allocation, oracle valuation, asset liquidity and delayed or unavailable settlement.

nuva.entry: For nvYLDS, verify Ethereum USDC, gas, deposit minimum and current location and screening terms before funding.
nuva.action: Preview depositing USDC and record nvYLDS shares. Review exposure to Figure-issued YLDS and cross-chain settlement.
nuva.exit: Check current screening and liquidity, preview the USDC withdrawal and track settlement. The terms describe up to two U.S. business days for the nvYLDS redemption period.
nuva.capital: Ethereum USDC plus gas; the guide lists a 1 USDC minimum. Verify the live quote and access terms.
nuva.fees: Quote gas and applicable protocol or conversion fees in the interface. No rate assumed.
nuva.settlement: Official terms list two U.S. business days for nvYLDS; confirm live conditions.
nuva.risks: Issuer and bridge dependencies, screening restrictions, depeg and withdrawal liquidity.

shift-defi.entry: Select the vault version, underlying deposit asset and available capacity in the Shift app.
shift-defi.action: Review the strategy and share price before depositing. Record shares and the withdrawal request terms.
shift-defi.exit: For v1, request redemption and claim after the stored timelock and batch resolution.
shift-defi.capital: Vault-specific underlying and gas; check current minimum.
shift-defi.fees: Maintenance and performance charges vary by vault. Trading, bridge and gas costs can apply.
shift-defi.settlement: V1 minimum waits: ltLLP four days; extUSD v1, vGRVT and hibaUSD seven days. Resolution can take longer.
shift-defi.risks: Venue failure, hedge mismatch, depeg and delayed claims.

doppler-finance.entry: Check jurisdiction first: the XRP Vault excludes US users and sanctioned regions.
doppler-finance.action: Use the official XRP vault interface and verify the destination details before transferring XRP.
doppler-finance.exit: Request the XRP withdrawal and monitor the next eligible batch.
doppler-finance.capital: XRP; confirm the live minimum and reserve network fees.
doppler-finance.fees: The guide lists network fees only for deposit and withdrawal.
doppler-finance.settlement: Seven-day withdrawal period; batches around 01:00 UTC afterward.
doppler-finance.risks: Custody exposure and inability to exit during the waiting period.

ember.entry: Select a specific Ember vault and inspect its underlying asset and strategy.
ember.action: Preview the deposit and record the vault shares issued at entry.
ember.exit: Redeem shares and compare the exit share price with entry. Inspect any pending request before assuming settlement.
ember.capital: Vault-specific deposit asset; confirm the minimum.
ember.fees: Obtain entry, exit and network quotes.
ember.settlement: The tutorial explains share redemption; a universal settlement time was not verified.
ember.risks: Share-price loss, strategy exposure and liquidity.

reti-pooling.entry: Inspect the validator, pool minimum and any asset or NFT gating criteria.
reti-pooling.action: Stake eligible ALGO through the dashboard and verify the validator position.
reti-pooling.exit: Choose unstake; check the residual balance rule or withdraw the entire position.
reti-pooling.capital: Validator-specific minimum ALGO plus transaction fees.
reti-pooling.fees: Confirm validator commission and wallet fees before signing.
reti-pooling.settlement: Use the pool dashboard to verify returned ALGO; no universal duration assumed.
reti-pooling.risks: Validator performance and pool-specific access restrictions.

figure-markets-prime.entry: Verify account and jurisdiction eligibility for the Prime lending marketplace.
figure-markets-prime.action: Submit a lender offer for the pool asset with an acceptable minimum rate; monitor auction matching.
figure-markets-prime.exit: Notify the platform to withdraw before the next settlement period. Verify removal and balance.
figure-markets-prime.capital: Eligible account and pool asset; consult offer limits.
figure-markets-prime.fees: Record applicable account and settlement charges from the current terms.
figure-markets-prime.settlement: Lender exits depend on settlement periods and order matching.
figure-markets-prime.risks: Collateral recovery, platform and liquidity risk.

tori-finance.entry: Distinguish market swaps from direct minting. Identity verification applies to direct mint and redeem.
tori-finance.action: Compare a USDC or USDT swap quote for trUSD, then inspect the strUSD staking terms.
tori-finance.exit: Unstake and compare secondary-market proceeds with an eligible direct redemption.
tori-finance.fees: Direct mint/redeem costs 0.1% per issuer FAQ; market swaps use quoted prices. Gas is additional.
tori-finance.settlement: Confirm the current unstaking window and execution quote.
tori-finance.risks: Synthetic-dollar backing and market liquidity; principal is uninsured.

gami-labs.entry: Locate Gami USDC on Lagoon. Confirm the named curator, address and public or private access.
gami-labs.action: Read the vault valuation and fee schedule, then request a USDC deposit and track settlement.
gami-labs.exit: Request redemption, track the valuation cycle and claim once assets become available.
gami-labs.capital: USDC and chain gas. Verify the vault minimum.
gami-labs.fees: Request chain quote and check management and performance charges.
gami-labs.settlement: Lagoon batches requests and settles at vault valuation; no fixed wait assumed.
gami-labs.risks: Curator exposure, valuation lag and queued liquidity.

tulipa-capital.entry: Select Tulipa USDC on Lagoon and verify the exact vault identity and access terms.
tulipa-capital.action: Request a USDC deposit against the stated strategy and retain the share balance.
tulipa-capital.exit: Request redemption and confirm settlement and claim availability through Lagoon.
tulipa-capital.capital: USDC and gas for this vault.
tulipa-capital.fees: Check vault-specific charges and transaction quotes.
tulipa-capital.risks: Market-neutral strategy execution, share valuation and exit delays.

clearstar.entry: Match the Arc USDC vault. A similarly named vault accepts vbUSDC. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
clearstar.action: Preview supplying USDC to Clearstar Core USDC. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
clearstar.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
clearstar.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
clearstar.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
clearstar.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
clearstar.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

armitage-by-wintermute.entry: Armitage lists Prime and Select separately. Inspect the Ethereum Select allocations. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
armitage-by-wintermute.action: Preview supplying USDC to Wintermute USDC Select. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
armitage-by-wintermute.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
armitage-by-wintermute.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
armitage-by-wintermute.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
armitage-by-wintermute.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
armitage-by-wintermute.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

keyrock.entry: Check the Keyrock Prime listing, vault owner and chain in the directory. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
keyrock.action: Preview supplying USDC to Keyrock Prime USDC. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
keyrock.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
keyrock.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
keyrock.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
keyrock.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
keyrock.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

rockawayx.entry: Distinguish USDC Yield from its Confidential RWA and ecosystem vaults. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
rockawayx.action: Preview supplying USDC to RockawayX USDC Yield. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
rockawayx.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
rockawayx.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
rockawayx.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
rockawayx.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
rockawayx.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

hyperithm.entry: The directory lists several Apex deployments and V1 variants. Verify the exact chain and version. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
hyperithm.action: Preview supplying USDC to Hyperithm USDC Apex. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
hyperithm.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
hyperithm.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
hyperithm.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
hyperithm.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
hyperithm.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

galaxy-curation.entry: Select the Arc listing. Quality, Enhanced and PYUSD are distinct products. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.
galaxy-curation.action: Preview supplying USDC to Galaxy USDC. Check the spender, shares received and underlying market exposures.
galaxy-curation.exit: Use the same vault withdrawal interface and compare the redeemable amount to available liquidity before confirming.
galaxy-curation.capital: USDC on the selected network plus gas. Check the contract minimum and current caps.
galaxy-curation.fees: Read the selected vault fee terms and wallet transaction quote. No universal fee rate assumed.
galaxy-curation.settlement: Redemption depends on liquidity accessible to this vault; no guaranteed settlement time.
galaxy-curation.risks: Borrower collateral, market liquidity, oracle and curator allocation risk.

loopscale-lending.entry: Select a single-asset Loopscale vault on Lend. Inspect its curator, collateral and idle-liquidity buffer.
loopscale-lending.action: Preview the deposit and record vault LP units. Curators allocate pooled funds; optimized idle liquidity can add external exposure.
loopscale-lending.exit: Check free LP balance. Compare the immediate exit quote with the queue and extra capital-days. Pledged LP is unavailable until debt is repaid.
loopscale-lending.capital: Selected vault asset and network fees.
loopscale-lending.fees: A low-liquidity immediate exit can carry a fee. Obtain the actual quote.
loopscale-lending.risks: Curator, collateral losses, external markets and delayed exit.

firelight.entry: Check the FXRP vault on Flare and its coverage exposure. Reserve FLR for gas.
firelight.action: Preview FXRP approval and deposit; the vault mints stXRP.
firelight.exit: Request unstaking, then return to claim FXRP after the window. Check period boundaries and redemption value.
firelight.fees: Quote approval, stake, unstake and withdrawal transactions.
firelight.settlement: With 30-day periods the documented exit window spans 30 to 60 days.
firelight.risks: Slashing can affect pending exits; emissions end at request.

polymarket-international.entry: Check international platform access for your location and read the market resolution rules before considering a position.
polymarket-international.action: Inspect the order book, pUSD cost and settlement. A matched order exchanges collateral for outcome tokens on Polygon.
polymarket-international.exit: Check available bids to sell, or redeem winning tokens after resolution. A losing position can exhaust principal.
polymarket-international.capital: Quoted collateral for the selected outcome.
polymarket-international.fees: Check market fee, spread and funding or withdrawal quotes.
polymarket-international.settlement: Selling requires a match; redemption depends on resolution.
polymarket-international.risks: Geographic restrictions, resolution disputes and full position loss.

mellow-core.entry: Match the deployment to the permissionless ERC20RootVault generation and verify its configured tokens and deposit permissions.
mellow-core.action: Preview the required basket. The root vault accepts tokens in its configured ratio and mints LP units.
mellow-core.exit: Preview burning LP against the lower TVL estimate. Check per-block limits and the assets available from subvaults.
mellow-core.fees: Inspect configured management, protocol and performance rates and transaction quotes.
mellow-core.settlement: Per-block limits can require staged withdrawal.
mellow-core.risks: Oracle estimates, strategy and subvault liquidity.
